summary: Become a certified ISO/IEC 27701 Lead Auditor. Our comprehensive training equips you with the knowledge to effectively manage privacy information systems.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who need to audit, support, or lead a privacy information management system based on ISO/IEC 27701:2025.
prerequisites: A fundamental understanding of information security and privacy, along with a comprehensive knowledge of audit principles, is required to attend this course.
